title: Supervised lever: feature+elicited cross-fit calibration on real CTR (#342)
design: 300 cases (two disjoint pre-registered slices). Reuse cached comparative+popshare Sonnet signals (no new LLM). Add FIXED rule-based structural diff features (len,nwords,num,q,excl,colon,caps,you,curio). LogisticRegression (default, max_iter=1000) in a StandardScaler pipeline. 5-fold StratifiedKFold, shuffle, seed=42. OUT-OF-FOLD predictions only. No feature selection, no tuning.
scoring: directional_gate G0-G11 on out-of-fold P(T wins)-0.5

hypotheses.H1: combined beats elicited_only on balanced SMR or Kendall tau_b (point)
hypotheses.H2: does any feature set CLEAR a GO bar the raw elicited signal missed (SMR>=0.70 OR tau_b>=0.30 OR tail>=0.80)?

decision_rule: If combined materially exceeds elicited_only and clears new GO bars -> supervised calibration is the lever to decision-grade; report + scale. If combined ~ elicited_only -> the elicited signal is the headline-only ceiling; structural features add nothing; honest stop for Upworthy.
